# Runtime dependencies — loose floors only. The exact, tested versions live in
# requirements.lock (generated by `make upgrade`, installed with --no-deps); bump
# versions there, gated by the test suite and the accuracy harnesses.

# Web framework + ASGI server
fastapi>=0.110
uvicorn[standard]>=0.29
# Multipart parsing for file uploads (POST /api/scan)
python-multipart>=0.0.9
# Computer vision. The "headless" build skips GUI/GL system libs, so the Docker
# image needs no extra apt packages (libGL etc).
opencv-python-headless>=4.9
numpy>=1.26
# EXIF-aware image decoding (corrects phone photo orientation)
Pillow>=10.2
# PostgreSQL driver (v3) + connection pool. [binary] bundles libpq, so the slim
# image needs no extra apt packages.
psycopg[binary]>=3.2
psycopg-pool>=3.2
# Identification, Stage 1.5: OCR of card names / collector lines. RapidOCR runs the
# PaddleOCR detector/classifier/recogniser as ONNX models on onnxruntime (CPU).
# NOTE: rapidocr declares the GUI `opencv-python`; overrides.txt removes that from
# resolution so the headless build stays the only provider of `cv2`.
onnxruntime>=1.20
rapidocr>=3.0
# Fuzzy matching of OCR'd names against the index (C++/SIMD, no torch).
rapidfuzz>=3.10
